notes.title: Version 1.0.04
notes.content:
[p]Version 1.0.04 of Darkest Mine is now live ![/p][p]A special thank you to zklowott for his valuable suggestions.[/p][p]Here is the changelog : [/p][h3]
DEBUG[/h3][list][*][p]The achievements "Thirdly" and "Fourthly" were swapped. This issue is now fixed.,[/p][/*][*][p]The up and down arrows now correctly adjust the attack direction.,[/p][/*][/list][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]In the depth level selection interface, the reward multiplier is now displayed.,[/p][/*][/list][h3]BALANCING[/h3][list][*][p]Nuggets are no longer the resource used to buy upgrades at the blacksmith in the HUB (players no longer need to worry about keeping them during expeditions). Instead, a new resource has been added: diamonds. Diamonds are collected during expeditions by defeating bosses (1, 2, 4, 7, and 10 diamonds for the 5 bosses respectively). In this update 1.0.04, your nugget stock will be converted into diamonds at a rate of 25 nuggets = 1 diamond.,[/p][/*][*][p]Boss “Crystatron” (NERF) : max HP reduced (1400 -> 1300).,[/p][/*][*][p]Boss “Infestalith” (NERF) : max HP reduced (1000 -> 850). Invincibility duration after a phase change reduced (4.5s -> 4.0s). Maximum number of summons in the room reduced. Delay between two cocoon summons reduced.,[/p][/*][*][p]Boss “Railtorque” (NERF) : overall speed reduced.,[/p][/*][*][p]Overall reduction of movement speed, damage, and HP values of regular and elite monsters.,[/p][/*][*][p]Slingshot projectiles now pass through semi-passable platforms.,[/p][/*][*][p]Dash is now faster but shorter.,[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to use the down arrow/analog stick to go down through semi-passable platforms (without using dash).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.03
notes.content:
[h1]DEBUG[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed errors in texts and translations.
[/list]


[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*]In some configurations, the game could switch abnormally from controller mode to keyboard/mouse mode. This issue is now fixed.
[/list]

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
[list]
[*]The base damage of the lance has been increased from 8 to 9.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.02
notes.content:
[h1]DEBUG[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed text errors in the game.
[*] When the player gained health / oil but had already reached the maximum limit of health/ oil, the text "Test" appeared above the player's head. This issue is now fixed.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Boss "Mechaboom" : The sound of the cannons has been slightly reduced.
[*] 
[/list]

[h1]BALANCING[/h1]
[list]
[*] Boss "Mechaboom" (BUFF) : The bomb's projection angle is now slightly random. Additionally, when a bomb hits the ground, it only explodes after a 1-second delay.
[*] Boss "Railtorque" (NERF) : The duration during which the monster remains static after an attack has been increased. Moreover, the functioning of the boss's second phase has been slightly modified. The boss's "wings" are not always deployed. After its first attack, only one of the two wings is now deployed, indicating the direction of its next attack. After its second attack, the deployed wing retracts before it returns to its initial position.
[*] Boss "Infestalith" (NERF) : A maximum number of summons depending on the boss phase has been added.
[*] Power "Defense? No need" : The damage bonus has been increased from 20% to 35%.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.01
notes.content:
[h1]DEBUG[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed text errors in the game.
[*] Power "Left / Right Half-Heart" : The max oil gain is now correctly removed for the next expedition.
[*] Powers "No More bobo" / "Suction" : The reward would appear above the character even if their health / oil bar was full. This issue is now fixed.
[*] Power "Combo" : The bonus would sometimes not properly reset when the player missed their target with the slingshot. This issue is now fixed.
[*] Power "Transfer" : If the player died while in a circle of light, their oil would no longer decrease during next expeditions. This issue is now fixed.
[*] The interface button allowing to abandon / return to the hub is no longer affected by key rebinding.
[*] When rebinding keys, the icon on the special attack bar now updates correctly.
[*] In the tutorial, it is now correctly indicated that the movement speed of an electrified monster is reduced by 45% (and not 50%).
[*] The player's hearts are now correctly centered in the converter interface.
[*] Weapon "Slingshot" : sometimes, when the stone was fired too close to a wall, it would be instantly destroyed. This issue is now fixed.
[*] Weapon "Slingshot" : the stone would sometimes not break upon hitting the ground if it landed right at the corner of a room's edge. This issue is now fixed.
[*] Monster "Square" : in some cases, the monster would continue to charge in one direction even after reaching the wall. This issue is now fixed.
[*] Achievement "Luminously" : The achievement now unlocks correctly when the player reaches 100 max oil.
[*] In some cases, the reward "+5 max oil" could be offered even when the player had already reached the max limit. This issue is now fixed.
[*] The last two tiers (4 and 5) of critical hit chance upgrades from the blacksmith are now correctly saved.
[/list]


[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1] 

[list]
[*] The text tabs of the HUB book interface have been replaced with icons.
[*] Achievement "Mechanically" : the achievement icon has been modified to be more representative.
[/list]


[h1]BALANCING[/h1]

[list]
[*] The upper part of the enemy hitbox has been slightly enlarged to make downward attacks easier.
[*] The purchasable upgrades at the blacksmith that increase critical hit chance, elementary effect chance, and elementary effect duration have been slightly increased.
[*] For a given oil level, the size of the light circle has been slightly reduced, and the size of the flashlight has been slightly increased.
[*] Boss "Railtorque" : the attack chaining speed has been slightly reduced.
[*] Weapon "Slingshot" : the speed and distance of the stone have been slightly increased.
[*] Weapon "Pickaxe" : the special attack has been modified. Now, the attack damage is doubled, but the attack area is only doubled (previously tripled).
[*] Power "Never 1 without 2" : the chance to choose a second power has increased from 5% to 8%.
[*] Power "Forward-looking" : the bonus has increased from 0.3% to 0.4% per oil.
[*] Power "Analysis" : the bonus now activates after 5 attacks (previously 8).
[*] Power "Boost" : the bonus has changed from 25% for 10 seconds to 75% for 15 seconds.
[*] Power "Combo" : the bonus is no longer reset when the player attacks an invulnerable monster.
[*] Family "Multiplier" : basic attack damage is now divided by 3 (previously 4).
[*] Achievement "Perfectly" : the achievement now allows 4 hits in an expedition to be validated.
[/list]
